minutes.headline: Planning Board set a seven-day application deadline and endorsed two ANR plans; three hearings were deferred or continued.
minutes.summary: The board approved the storm water permit decision for 274 Prospect Street, endorsed ANR plans for 20 Buttonwood Place and 318 Howard Street, and deferred or continued all three scheduled public hearings. It voted a policy that application materials be submitted at least seven calendar days before the meeting. Committee reports centred on growing interest in townwide comprehensive storm water management.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted a policy that application materials be received at least seven calendar days before the meeting, a Monday before a Monday meeting.
The board approved the storm water permit for 274 Prospect Street with its standard conditions; one member abstained.
The board endorsed ANR plans for 20 Buttonwood Place and for 318 Howard Street.
All three scheduled hearings were put off: 360 Flat Hill Road deferred to December 11th, and 171 Arbor Street and 255 Sunny Hill Road continued to November 27th.
The board said it wants to work with other town boards on townwide storm water management, to be relayed to the capital planning committee.

why_it_matters: Anyone filing an application with the Planning Board now has to submit it a full week before the meeting, so late filings will wait for a later meeting.
Storm water management is moving toward a capital planning question, which can become a funding request and a vote residents are asked to take.
